# Alerter native macOS helper

Bundled ARM64 executable from Alerter v26.5:
https://github.com/vjeantet/alerter/releases/tag/v26.5

Download: https://github.com/vjeantet/alerter/releases/download/v26.5/alerter-26.5.zip

Archive sha256:11f63cddc9bb3f8554ed9b762632a120cfa7bee05e3c09d65734823e09d24f10

Executable SHA-256: 76030771f0b09f8ac74f28ea830bdae81a366a3bf5bf259b3bc311a864553d6c

Requires macOS 13 or newer. Upstream signs and notarizes its release. The
executable is copied without modification so its embedded signature is retained.
The Intel backend uses the existing terminal-notifier application bundle.

Source: https://github.com/vjeantet/alerter/tree/v26.5
